preconditions.description: Length of str1 is between 1 and 1000.
Length of str2 is between 1 and 1000.
All characters in str1 are lowercase English letters.
All characters in str2 are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: str1 is a subsequence of the returned string.
str2 is a subsequence of the returned string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == min(len(scs) for scs in supersequences(str1, str2))
postconditions.description: The length of the returned string is the minimum possible length among all common supersequences of str1 and str2.
